data.name: Raafiqa
data.gender_notes: Raafiqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who keeps the gardens and maintains their fragrance. The name Raafiqa carries the meaning “Gardener, Fragrant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Raafiqa usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, fragrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who nurtures and maintains spiritual growth
data.etymology: Raafiqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, Fragrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raafiqa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رَافِقَة
in_arabic.meaning: رَافِقَة تعني الرفيق في اللغة العربية، الشخص الذي يرافق ويدعم
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَافِقَة هو اسم مشتق من الفعل رافق، والذي يعني المصاحبة والمواكبة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يرافق ويدعم الآخرين في مختلف الظروف. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يُعبر هذا الاسم عن الصفات الحميدة مثل الرفق والتعاون.

in_urdu.name: رافقة
in_urdu.meaning: رافقة کا مطلب ہے صحبت کرنے والی، دلی سے جڑی ہوئی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رافقة عربی زبان کے الفعل رافق سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے صحبت کرنا یا کسی کے ساتھ رہنا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کے اندر ہوتی ہیں جیسے کہ وفاداری، دلی سے جڑے رہنا، اور دوسروں کی حمایت کرنا۔ اسلامی روایات میں، یہ نام ان نساء کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے خاندان اور دوستوں کے ساتھ گہرا تعلق رکھتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: राफिका
in_hindi.meaning: राफिका का अर्थ है साथ देने वाली, दिल से जुड़ी हुई
in_hindi.long_meaning: राफिका नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया राफिक से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है साथ देना या किसी के साथ रहना। हिंदी में, यह नाम उन विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है जो एक व्यक्ति के भीतर होती हैं जैसे कि वफादारी, दिल से जुड़े रहना, और दूसरों की सहायता करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन महिलाओं के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने परिवार और मित्रों के साथ गहरा संबंध रखती हैं।

in_pashto.name: رافيقه
in_pashto.meaning: رافيقه يعني د ملتی سړی، هغه چا چې د نورو سره وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رافيقه د عربي ژبې د فعل رافق څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې وي د ملتی سړی يا د چا سره ملګری. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغو ځانګړتیاوو څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي لکه د وفادارۍ، د زړه له تړاو، او د نورو د مرستې لپاره. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د هغو ښځو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خپلې کورنۍ او دوستانو سره نږدې اړیکه لري.

in_english.name: Raafiqa
in_english.meaning: Companion, supporter, one who accompanies and supports others
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raafiqa is derived from the Arabic root 'R-F-Q', which means to accompany or to support. In Islamic tradition, Raafiqa symbolizes the qualities of companionship, loyalty, and support. This name is often given to girls born into families that value close relationships and community ties. Historically, the name reflects the importance of social bonds and mutual support in Islam. Personality traits associated with Raafiqa include being a caring friend, a loyal companion, and a supportive individual.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raafiqa is of Arabic origin and carries a deep connection to gardens and nature. In Islamic culture, gardens and nature are often seen as symbols of beauty, tranquility, and peace. The name Raafiqa can be associated with a person who has a nurturing and caring nature, just like how a gardener tends to his gardens. This name can also symbolize a person who maintains and supports their loved ones with love and devotion, keeping their hearts filled with joy and harmony.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Raafiqa carries the significance of maintaining and nurturing our inner gardens of the soul. Just like how a gardener tends to his plants and keeps them thriving, a person named Raafiqa is called to tend to their own spiritual growth and development. This name can serve as a reminder to stay connected to the Divine and keep our hearts filled with love, kindness, and compassion towards ourselves and others. Through this practice, we can cultivate a beautiful and fragrant spiritual garden within ourselves, bringing peace, joy, and fulfillment to our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gardener, Fragrant" symbolizes The one who keeps the gardens and maintains their fragrance. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raafiqa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gardener, fragrant.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Raafiqa bint Abd al-Harith ibn al-Nu'man was a poetess and a Sufi saint from the Arabian Peninsula. The name Raafiqa carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Raafiqa was a prominent figure in the early Sufi movement and is known for her poetry and spiritual teachings.

modern_usage.modern_context: Raafiqa is remembered and revered in modern times for her contributions to Sufism and Islamic spirituality. Her poetry continues to be studied and recited, and her teachings are a source of inspiration for many.
